# django-rtl-admin

> django-rtl-admin extends Django's stock admin with logical-property RTL styling, opt-in Unicode bidirectional-text isolation, locale-aware formatting helpers, and a language switcher. It supports Python 3.10+ and Django 4.2+ on compatible combinations, preserves the stock admin, and does not change stored values.

## Start here

- [Installation](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/installation/): requirements, pip installation, app order, static files, and custom template inheritance.
- [Quick start](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/quick-start/): language configuration, LocaleMiddleware, the set_language endpoint, BidiSafeAdminMixin, and template filters.
- [Arabic quick start](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/ar/quick-start/): the complete setup guide in Arabic.

## Capabilities and limits

- Logical CSS properties fix physical spacing in stock-admin controls; CSS does not rewrite model values.
- BidiSafeAdminMixin is an explicit opt-in for Unicode isolation of eligible changelist values.
- Python helpers and template filters isolate whole values or embedded opposite-direction runs.
- Number, currency, percentage, and date/time formatting helpers are explicit opt-ins.
- Babel is optional. Without it, Django formatting and digit transliteration provide a fallback.
- The language switcher POSTs with CSRF protection to Django's set_language view and preserves the current path and query string.
- The package ships Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Urdu catalogs. A project's LANGUAGES setting controls its own switcher.
- Third-party admin theme compatibility is not guaranteed.

## Reference

- [Configuration](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/configuration/): all RTL_ADMIN settings and defaults.
- [Template tags and filters](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/template-tags/): bidi, formatting, direction, assets, and language helpers.
- [BidiSafeAdminMixin](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/admin-mixin/): changelist isolation, sorting, exclusions, and security behavior.
- [Python API](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/api/): bidi and locale-formatting functions.
- [Stock admin RTL defects](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/rtl-defects/): source-level before/after details and limitations.
- [System checks](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/system-checks/): rtl_admin.W001 through W004.
- [Translations](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/translations/): shipped locales and contribution workflow.
- [Changelog](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/changelog/): release history.
- [Full documentation for language models](https://django-rtl-admin.readthedocs.io/llms-full.txt)
